status_note: Detailed concept risk register. All entries remain open or monitoring.

risks.trigger_zh: 用途漂移、过度字段、再识别或删除失败
risks.trigger_en: Purpose drift, excess fields, re-identification or failed deletion
risks.degrade_action_zh: 立即冻结访问，切换合成/人工路径并通知受影响者
risks.degrade_action_en: Freeze access, switch to synthetic/human route and notify affected people
risks.recovery_evidence_zh: 删除/隔离证明、权限复核、独立复演
risks.recovery_evidence_en: Deletion/isolation proof, privilege review and independent replay

risks.trigger_zh: 机器人越界、急停失败、错误导航或高温暴雨风险
risks.trigger_en: Robot breach, failed stop, unsafe route or severe weather
risks.degrade_action_zh: 立即停机/隔离/人工疏导
risks.degrade_action_en: Immediate stop, isolation and human routing
risks.recovery_evidence_zh: 双人急停、现场复核、恢复演练通过
risks.recovery_evidence_en: Two-person stop, field check and recovery drill pass

risks.trigger_zh: 无账号、老人、残障者或非中文用户无法取得等价服务
risks.trigger_en: No-account, older, disabled or non-Chinese user loses equivalent service
risks.degrade_action_zh: 关闭增强层，恢复柜台/电话/纸面/触觉路径
risks.degrade_action_en: Close AI layer and restore desk/phone/paper/tactile route
risks.recovery_evidence_zh: 最差组实走与受影响群体共同签字
risks.recovery_evidence_en: Worst-group field audit and affected-group co-signoff

risks.trigger_zh: 无排班、培训、备岗、补偿或维护预算
risks.trigger_en: No staffing, training, backup, compensation or maintenance budget
risks.degrade_action_zh: 不扩容并缩短开放时段
risks.degrade_action_en: Do not expand; reduce operating hours
risks.recovery_evidence_zh: 具名岗位、工时/成本包络和备用班组确认
risks.recovery_evidence_en: Named roles, labour/cost envelope and backup shift confirmed

risks.trigger_zh: 非原团队无法运行、导出、修复或退场
risks.trigger_en: Non-origin team cannot run, export, repair or retire
risks.degrade_action_zh: 拒绝毕业与付款节点，保留人工服务
risks.degrade_action_en: Block graduation and payment milestone; retain manual service
risks.recovery_evidence_zh: Teach-back 六项能力复演通过

risks.trigger_zh: 来源、许可、人物/标志或撤回权不清
risks.trigger_en: Unknown source, licence, person/mark or withdrawal right
risks.degrade_action_en: Hide or hold disputed asset first
risks.recovery_evidence_zh: 权利台账、授权、引用和撤回执行完成
risks.recovery_evidence_en: Rights register, consent, citation and withdrawal complete

risks.trigger_zh: 把 provisional 边界、概念设施或目标值当作红线/批准
risks.trigger_en: Treat provisional geometry, concept asset or target as approved control
risks.degrade_action_zh: 撤回误导表达并停止精确设计
risks.degrade_action_en: Withdraw misleading claim and stop precision design
risks.recovery_evidence_zh: official 数据替换、全链重算和专业审查
risks.recovery_evidence_en: Official replacement, full-chain recalculation and professional review

risks.trigger_zh: 投诉受报复、初审人与申诉复核人未隔离
risks.trigger_en: Retaliation or no separation between initial and appeal reviewers
risks.immediate_owner_zh: 受影响群体联络/独立复核
risks.degrade_action_zh: 暂停对应场景，保护申诉者并重派复核
risks.degrade_action_en: Pause scenario, protect appellant and reassign review
risks.recovery_evidence_zh: 独立决定、公开去标识结论与纠正
risks.recovery_evidence_en: Independent decision, public de-identified finding and remedy

risks.trigger_zh: 不可复现、权限越界、关键结果漂移或人工接管超时
risks.trigger_en: Irreproducible, excess privilege, drift or late takeover
risks.recovery_evidence_zh: 独立复测、权限最小化和接管演练
risks.recovery_evidence_en: Independent retest, least privilege and takeover drill

risks.trigger_zh: 无法计量能耗/水/热、设施容量不明或生态维护中断
risks.trigger_en: Unmetered energy/water/heat, unknown capacity or failed ecological maintenance
risks.degrade_action_zh: 暂停高耗任务并转人工巡查
risks.degrade_action_en: Pause high-load task and use human patrol
risks.recovery_evidence_zh: 资源基线、容量专业复核和维护计划
risks.recovery_evidence_en: Resource baseline, professional capacity check and maintenance plan
